title: fix(scenarios): each card persona's role states the writes its build prompt did not
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoHnY9LA8HUaCTtrGYLcCo2G)_

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

Fixes #33597

> The order's HOLD is lifted: eval#1 recorded its replay on `main` `36936440` (mailbox #33602, comment 6890573292).

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：13 个场景卡角色的 `role` 文字补上了它要做或被禁止做的写操作（对象 + 动词），另加一个测试：每张卡的每个写操作都必须在该卡的构建 prompt 里写明。
- 为什么改：#33630 让 Build 按卡片检查权限集，但有 19 个写操作在构建 prompt 里根本没提，AI 搭建时无从知道该给这个权限；按 eval#1 的裁定，用角色字符串补上。
- 风险与回滚：只改卡片 JSON 的 `run.personas[].role` 和测试，不动 schema、runner、prompt 代码；角色文字也会出现在运行时的“You act for …”里，所以这几个角色的运行 prompt 会变。回滚即 revert。
- 先看：`test/score/scenario-cards.test.ts` 末尾的 TRACE 表（40 个写操作各自的出处），以及下方前后对照表。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios exec vitest run test/score/scenario-cards.test.ts`（21 项全绿）。
- 需要你做的：无；eval#1 的回放已记录，席位审查后合并。

## What changes

**The rule (done-when 2 of #33597, verbatim):** 「The build prompt states nothing new: the grants already trace to the prompt through the data contract (`docs/qa/scenarios/README.md` "Build checks trace to the prompt"); if a grant does not, the card is fixed instead.」 The library's owner (eval#1, 05:52Z) ruled the carrier: each persona's `role` string, naming the object and the verbs; no new card field, no schema, runner or prompt change. The seat ruled the scope: a write need is untraced only when the card's whole rendered build prompt (`buildPrompt`) never states it for that persona; fix those and name them.

**Re-derived over every card.** `personaGrantNeeds` over the nine cards of `docs/qa/scenarios/` gives 40 write needs (32 needed, 8 refused `PERMISSION_DENIED`). Each was read against its card's rendered build prompt. 21 are stated by the card's prose; 19 were not, and their persona's role now states them.

| Card | Persona | Write need(s) not stated before | Role before | Role after |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| crm_account_with_contacts | sdr | contact create, update, delete | Sales development representative | Sales development representative who adds, updates and removes contacts |
| crm_account_with_contacts | partner_user | account update (refused) | Partner portal user | Partner portal user who may not change accounts |
| invoice_with_line_items | sales_rep | invoice_line create, delete; invoice update | Sales representative | Sales representative who adds and removes invoice lines and sends invoices |
| invoice_with_line_items | warehouse_staff | invoice update (refused) | Warehouse staff | Warehouse staff who may read invoices but not change them |
| project_with_tasks | contractor | task create, update, delete | External contractor | External contractor who logs, updates and removes their own tasks |
| project_with_tasks | client_viewer | task update (refused) | Client stakeholder | Client stakeholder who may not change tasks |
| leave_balances | hr_officer | leave_request delete | HR officer, organization-wide — e13 | …, who deletes withdrawn leave requests |
| leave_balances | employee | leave_balance update (refused) | Employee, Engineering, two years of service — e07 | …, who may not change their own leave balance |
| service_desk | team_lead | ticket update (reassign, close) | Team lead, Technical group — a04 | …, who reassigns and closes their group's tickets |
| service_desk | support_agent | ticket create (logged from a call) | Support agent, Billing group — a02 | …, who logs tickets from customer calls |
| asset_lifecycle | asset_admin | asset create | IT asset administrator, organization-wide - e12 | …, who registers assets |
| asset_lifecycle | employee | disposal_request update (refused) | Employee (asset holder), Sales - e06 | …, who may not approve their own disposal requests |
| travel_expense | employee | approval_step update (refused) | Employee (claimant), Sales, grade g2 — e02 | …, who may not approve approval steps on their own claims |

The seat's list (seat record 6889635350) named the first seven rows' needs. The re-derivation adds six personas' needs on starter cards, each one the prose does not state for that persona:
- service desk team lead: the prose says only that a lead "sees" their group's tickets;
- service desk agent: the prose has the customer raise tickets, not the agent log one;
- asset create: "Assets are registered" names no one;
- leave employee balance refusal, asset employee approval refusal, travel employee approval refusal: the prose names who approves or computes, but never says that the employee may not.

The 21 needs the prose states, with the passages, are the `TRACES` table in the test, for example order_to_cash sales_rep sales_order update refused ← "a rep cannot approve their own order" and travel_expense finance_officer expense_claim update ← "once Finance approves, Finance pays it".

**The pin** (`packages/qa/scenarios/test/score/scenario-cards.test.ts`, section 3 TRACE). It maps every write need of the library to where its build prompt states it:
- `ROLE` entries: the persona's role, judged by a plain text rule. The role must name the object (its machine name with `_` read as a space, plural allowed) and a verb word for that verb class. A refused write also needs a negation ("may not", "but not", "cannot", "never"). The test also checks that the role is rendered in the prompt's persona line.
- Prose entries: the quoted passages, each required verbatim in the rendered build prompt.

A new write need with no entry, an entry for a need that no longer exists, a role that stops naming its write, or a quoted passage edited out of the prose: each is a red. Limits are stated in the test. The rule reads words, not grammar: it does not check that the verb word governs the object, or which object a negation applies to. A prose trace is a reviewer's reading, pinned so it cannot silently stop being true. The verb word lists are the verbs the library's roles use; a new one is added in the open.

**Run prompts move too.** `role` also renders in each operation's run prompt ("You act for <role>", `prompts.ts`). The 13 edited personas' run prompts change, on all seven cards touched. The recorded fixture `test/runner/fixtures/eval-r1-build-denial.recording.json` replays by its replay key (`card/mode/half/operation/persona`), not by prompt text, so it needed no re-pin, and its suite passes unchanged.

**Files.** Seven card JSONs, `run.personas[].role` only (`asset_lifecycle`, `crm_account_with_contacts`, `invoice_with_line_items`, `leave_balances`, `project_with_tasks`, `service_desk`, `travel_expense`), with no title, `zh`/`en` or other prose touched. Plus `test/score/scenario-cards.test.ts` (the pin) and `test/runner/units.test.ts` (one pinned prompt line carrying the sdr role). The cards ship in the package's `dist/library` (`scripts/pack-library.mjs`; `files[]` holds `dist`), so there is a patch changeset. No `src/**`, schema, runner or prompt code changes.

## Verification

Head `7702fe40`, one commit on `origin/main` `36936440` (which holds #33630).

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios build` exit 0, then `pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios test`: 32 files, 763 passed (`packed-tarball.test.ts` reads the rebuilt `dist/library` byte for byte). `tsc --noEmit` exit 0. Root eslint (`--no-inline-config`) on the two touched test files exit 0.
- Ablations through `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, each restored to the HEAD blob with `git diff HEAD` empty:
  - the contractor's role back to "External contractor": 1 red;
  - one quoted prose passage reworded ("no agent can change" → "no agent may change" in `service_desk.json`): 1 red;
  - the `leave_balances` hr_officer entry deleted from the table: 2 red.
- Derived gates: `dispatch-gates --commands` listed 61; each ran with `</dev/null`. `check:cross-package-test-inputs` first exited 1: the pin listed `docs/qa/scenarios/` with its own `readdirSync`, a read no declared glob covers. It now loads the library through the package's `loadScenarios`, as `test/library.test.ts` does, and the gate re-ran exit 0. All 61 `:: exit 0`; the `--ran` reconciliation is 61 derived, 61 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. Changed lines: 165 (+149 / -16, 10 files).

## Acceptance notes

- The six starter-card needs above go beyond the seat's list; each is named with the reason the prose does not state it. If the owner reads one as stated, its role edit can be reverted, and its table entry becomes a prose quote.
- The assignee and reviewer steps were skipped by order (relay draft, no reviewers).
